name: Retailer Service 3 Code
definition: List of specific services for ServiceResponse.

FSPP.name: Financial Payment Response
FSPP.definition: The POI System sends a response to a payment request (Purchase/refund/PWCB/MOTO Payment/...).

FSRP.name: Financial Reversal Response
FSRP.definition: The POI System sends a response to a reversal request.

FSIP.name: Financial Balance Inquiry Response
FSIP.definition: The POI System sends a response to a Balance Inquiry request.

FSBP.name: Financial Batch Response
FSBP.definition: The POI System sends a response to a batch processing request.

FSLP.name: Financial Loyalty Response
FSLP.definition: The POI System sends a response to a loyalty processing request.

FSVP.name: Financial Stored Value Response
FSVP.definition: The POI System sends a response to a stored value card or account request.

FSEP.name: Financial Enable Service Response
FSEP.definition: The POI System sends a response after enabling or not some service.

FSAP.name: Financial Card Acquisition Response
FSAP.definition: The POI System sends a response to a card data acquisition request.

FSCP.name: Financial Reconciliation Response
FSCP.definition: The POI System sends a response to a reconciliation request.
